title: Required Risk Capital decomposes into three additive risk types per Instance, then aggregates across an Agent's Instances
content:
A.3.2 requires Prime Agents investing Sky's Collateral Portfolio through the Allocation System Primitive to hold Risk Capital "to protect Sky from potential losses." A.3.2.1.1.3 defines the unit of account: "the Instance Total RRC for an Instance is equal to the sum of the Instance Financial RRC, Instance Smart Contract RRC, and Instance Administrative RRC." A.3.2.1.1.2 then aggregates: Aggregate RRC is the sum of Instance Total RRC over every Active Instance the Agent has deployed.

Two choices are embedded in that arithmetic. First, the three risk types are **additive**, not combined under any correlation assumption — a protocol that is simultaneously financially risky, technically complex and administratively centralized pays the full sum. Second, aggregation across Instances is a plain sum, so **spreading capital across Instances earns no diversification credit at the Agent level** even though the individual RRC calculations do model diversification internally.

A.3.2.1.1.1 supplies the dual representation that makes requirements portable: a requirement may be stated as an absolute RRC amount or as a Capital Ratio Requirement (CRR), where RRC = invested capital × CRR. The worked example is a 5% CRR on 100,000,000 USDS invested giving 5,000,000 USDS of RRC. CRR can be set in aggregate, per Instance, or per risk type within an Instance — so the same framework expresses both a modelled output and an administratively imposed number.

A.3.2.1.1.3.1 flags the structure as unfinished: additional RRC types "including legal risk and oracle risk, will be incorporated in future iterations." Because the composition rule is a sum, adding a type can only increase requirements — the framework is designed to be extended monotonically.
description: Instance Total RRC = Financial + Smart Contract + Administrative RRC; Aggregate RRC is the sum over Active Instances, with no diversification credit between Instances or risk types.
